message.content: {"note_claim": "The video's narration falsely claims some 9/11 hijackers survived and were victims of identity theft; the FBI confirmed all 19 hijackers were identified and died in the crashes.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "The FBI is confident that it has positively identified the nineteen hijackers responsible for the 9/11 terrorist attacks.", "reason": "The page shows the FBI positively identified all 19 hijackers and explains early name confusion, but it does not say they all died in the crashes or address the video's identity-theft narration."}

parsed.note_claim: The video's narration falsely claims some 9/11 hijackers survived and were victims of identity theft; the FBI confirmed all 19 hijackers were identified and died in the crashes.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: The FBI is confident that it has positively identified the nineteen hijackers responsible for the 9/11 terrorist attacks.
parsed.reason: The page shows the FBI positively identified all 19 hijackers and explains early name confusion, but it does not say they all died in the crashes or address the video's identity-theft narration.
